source.events: rate/2,rate,3*rate/2; exact integers at these rates
source.impulse: One sample at each known event+channel delay
source.attack: 100 ms support; min(1,t/1ms)*exp(-t/20ms)*(0.8*sin(1000Hz*t)+0.4*sin(2300Hz*t)); delays retained in physical frames
source.bed: Continuous0.25*(sin(440Hz*time)+0.4*sin(730Hz*time)) independently of attack delay, both channels; intentionally difficult onset landmarks

processing.mode: Existing constant v4 R3/copy; integer origin, no added context, pitch0,formantPreserved=false; unchanged processor/cache identities
processing.duration: Exact independently calculated ceil(frames*n/d), rate/channels unchanged; finite entire PCM; raw hash unchanged

detector.onset: First causal RMS sample >=threshold inside window
detector.unresolved: No energy/crossing; first crossing at boundary; no background window; background maximum >=threshold. Never count unresolved as a pass.
detector.calibration: Run identical detector on each original channel/event; expected output onset = exact rational(source calibrated onset*n/d). Unity must reproduce identical onset and PCM.
detector.timingGate: Absolute calibrated onset drift strictly <1ms: abs(frame delta)*1000/rate<1. Preserve exact rational delta; no added tolerance.
detector.preecho: Record processed RMS of20ms ending1ms before mapped raw event; divide by RMS of100ms beginning at mapped raw event. For silent families compare<=-40dB; bed records baseline/excess only, no silent-floor pass.
detector.physicalDelay: Record output interchannel detected arrival difference minus original calibrated difference (unscaled). Separate from nominal scaled marker delay; no group phase claim.
